shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' ."

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts && printf '\\n--- chartkit component ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.d.ts && printf '\\n--- yagr types ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts && printf '\\n--- yagr widget ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.d.ts && printf '\\n--- package dts ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build -maxdepth 2 -name 'index.d.ts' -print -exec cat {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "rg \"interface MinimalValidConfig|type MinimalValidConfig|interface RawSerieData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr -g '*.d.ts' -n && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/import {ChartKit} from '@gravity-ui\\/chartkit';/import ChartKit from '@gravity-ui\\/chartkit';/\" src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx
sed -i \"s/import {SegmentedRadioGroup, Spinner}/import {Loader, SegmentedRadioGroup}/; s/<Spinner size=\\\"m\\\" \\/>/<Loader size=\\\"m\\\" \\/>/\" src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/        data=>\\{\\n          timeline,\\n          graphs: \\[/        data=>\\{\\n          graphs: \\[/g\" src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx
perl -0pi -e \"s/        libraryConfig=>\\{\\n          title:/        libraryConfig=>\\{\\n          timeline,\\n          title:/g\" src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/          timeline,\\n          graphs:/          graphs:/g\" src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx
perl -0pi -e \"s/        libraryConfig=\\{\\{/        libraryConfig=\\{\\{\\n          timeline,/g\" src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "rg \"export type YagrWidgetData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit -g '*.d.ts' && rg -n \"graphs\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.d.ts && rg \"declare module '@gravity-ui/yagr'|export type \\*|export \\* from './types\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && head -1 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && npx tsc --traceResolution --noEmit 2>&1 | rg \"Resolving module '@gravity-ui/yagr'|Module resolution kind|url '.*yagr\" | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json | head -80 && cat node_modules/uplot/package.json | head -50 2>/dev/null || echo no-uplot'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"declare module '@gravity-ui/yagr'|uplot\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -30 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/polyfills.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"matchMedia|declare global\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -20 && rg -n \"matchMedia|declare global\" node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.d.ts | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/data={{/data={{\\n          data: {/' src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for path_name in ['src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx', 'src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx']:
    path = Path(path_name)
    text = path.read_text()
    text = text.replace(\"        libraryConfig={{\\n\", \"          },\\n          libraryConfig: {\\n\", 1)
    # Indent all lines after libraryConfig until closing of the libraryConfig block
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    start_idx = next((idx for idx, line in enumerate(lines) if 'libraryConfig: {' in line), None)
    if start_idx is not None:
        indent_level = 10
        closing_idx = next((idx for idx in range(start_idx, len(lines)) if lines[idx].startswith('        }}')), None)
        if closing_idx is not None:
            for idx in range(start_idx + 1, closing_idx + 1):
                if lines[idx].strip():
                    lines[idx] = '  ' + lines[idx]
                else:
                    lines[idx] = lines[idx]
            lines[closing_idx] = lines[closing_idx].replace('        }}', '          },\\n        }}')
        path.write_text(''.join(lines))
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i '/x: {type: '\\''category'\\'', time: true},/d' src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx
sed -i '/x: {type: '\\''time'\\''},/d' src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx
# Remove the now-empty axes blocks for both charts.
sed -i '/"'^          axes: {$/,/''^          },$/{/''^          axes: {$/d;/''^          },$/d}'"' src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx
sed -i 's/        data={{\\n          data: {/        data={{\\n          data: {\\n            timeline,/' src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx
# Add timeline to the sales chart manually.
sed -i '0,/          data: {/s//          data: {\\n            timeline,/' src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc 'grep -n "as VisualizationMode" src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx && grep -n "onUpdate" src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -40'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/onUpdate={(value) => setSelectedMode(value as VisualizationMode)}/onUpdate={setSelectedMode}/' src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx
sed -i 's/<SegmentedRadioGroup"'$/<SegmentedRadioGroup<VisualizationMode>/'"' src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx && printf '\\n--- sales ---\\n' && cat src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx && printf '\\n--- monitoring ---\\n' && cat src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && git diff -- src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/visualization/VisualizationWidget.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- sales ---\\n'; nl -ba src/visualization/sales-chart.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- monitoring ---\\n'; nl -ba src/visualization/monitoring-chart.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; nl -ba src/visualization/types.ts"
